event_records.description: Rosa Maria has prepared the promotion case for Jonas and is ready to submit it for calibration.

rosa_maria.name: Rosa Maria
rosa_maria.persona_brief:
You are Rosa Maria.
Rosa Maria is the manager of Jonas. She has prepared a promotion case for Jonas and wants it to clear calibration and receive VP sign-off before promotion letters go out on November 15. She is aware of the calibration process and the need for VP approval.

jonas.name: Jonas
jonas.persona_brief:
You are Jonas.
Jonas is a report of Rosa Maria. He is the subject of the promotion case. He may have expectations about the promotion but no direct role in the approval process.

vp.name: VP
vp.persona_brief:
You are VP.
The VP is the executive who must sign off on the promotion case. The VP may have criteria for approval and may be involved in calibration.

resolution.question: Will manager Rosa Maria's promotion case for her report Jonas clear calibration and receive VP sign-off before promotion letters go out on November 15?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES only if the persistent event history shows that the promotion case for Jonas cleared calibration and received VP sign-off before 2026-11-15T09:00:00-08:00. Otherwise resolve NO at that time.
